en: Fixed auto mode running behind a gateway at `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` on a model whose gateway name contains "haiku"; such a model, other than `claude-haiku-5-5`, is now refused, as Haiku 4.5 is
zh: 修复了自动模式在 `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` 网关后运行、且模型网关名称包含“haiku”时的问题；此类模型（`claude-haiku-5-5` 除外）现在会被拒绝，与 Haiku 4.5 一致
